name: sonus-auris-console-e2e
description: End-to-end browser smokes for the Sonus Auris console web build, driven by both Puppeteer and Playwright under node:test.

scripts.pretest: node -e "require('fs').existsSync('../build/web/index.html')||(console.error('Run: flutter build web --release (from the app root) before e2e'),process.exit(1))"
